items.title: Zcash seals $1.7 billion shielded pool as Ironwood upgrade activates
items.summary: The upgrade retires Orchard, where a counterfeiting bug sat undetected for four years. Every coin inside now has to leave through a gate that caps withdrawals at verified deposits.

items.title: Lido upgrade aims to slash Ethereum’s validator count by one-third
items.summary: Lido launched Curated Module v2, an upgrade that could reduce Ethereum’s validator count by one-third by consolidating validators and introducing new operator rules.

items.summary: We’re running Patch the Planet, an ongoing collaboration with OpenAI that pairs Trail of Bits engineers directly with more than 30 open-source projects. Its goal is to front-run a serious problem facing open-source maintainers: highly capable models like GPT-5.5-Cyber will soon c

items.title: Live updates: Bitcoin clears $64,000 in Asia hours ahead of Fed decision
items.summary: Markets price a hold at Wednesday's decision, but a real minority sees a surprise hike, with Citadel Securities and UBS among those flagging the risk.

items.title: Wall Street veteran Don Wilson says regulators are getting perps all wrong
items.summary: DRW CEO Don Wilson says perpetual futures aren't inherently risky crypto gambling tools, and it’s time traditional markets and regulators start embracing them.

items.title: Ionic Digital jumps 26% in Nasdaq debut, giving Celsius Network claimholders an exit route
items.summary: The bitcoin miner reached a market valuation of roughly $2.8 billion based on its 44.9 million shares outstanding.

items.title: Russia charges Telegram founder Pavel Durov with aiding terrorism
items.summary: The charges could result in life imprisonment, escalating an investigation that has already led to over 100 million rubles in fines for the platform this year.

items.title: SpaceX is a battleground Solana must win
items.summary: Perps are a trojan horse to bring all of traditional finance onchain, argues Brian Smith, president of the Jito Foundation.

items.title: Company behind AI trade that caused $60 million crypto liquidations to cover all losses
items.summary: The mark price fell 19% on a single pre-market trade in Korea. The company says its oracle worked exactly as designed.

items.title: Citadel bets on a Fed rate hike Wednesday as bitcoin analysts call a hold. Someone will be wrong.
items.summary: Citadel's macro team says Wednesday's hike isn't about the data. It's about Warsh's best shot at making a surprise actually count before the market stops being surprised.

items.title: Bitcoin rises toward $64,000 as Korea's record chip crash leaves crypto untouched
items.summary: SK Hynix fell 17% after profit rose 557% and still missed estimates. Bitcoin is up 1%, and the Fed decides rates today.

items.title: Hungary repeals crypto checks as first MiCA license is granted
items.summary: Hungary removed mandatory third-party checks for crypto conversions as CoinCash received authorization to provide digital asset services under MiCA.

items.title: Trump teleprompter operator accused over Kalshi bets leaves government: AP
items.summary: Gabriel Perez, who was accused of profiting from Kalshi bets tied to President Donald Trump’s speeches, is no longer employed by the federal government.

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs extend outflow streak as BTC fails to hold $65K
items.summary: US spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded four straight sessions of outflows totaling $526 million as Bitcoin faced renewed selling pressure after failing to hold $65,000.

items.title: UK policy sprint finds cross-border payments are stablecoins’ top use case
items.summary: Industry participants said stablecoins offer the biggest near-term benefits for cross-border payments, while domestic UK retail adoption is likely to remain limited.

items.title: Telegram founder Pavel Durov internationally wanted, Russia’s FSB says
items.summary: Russia’s FSB says Telegram founder Pavel Durov faces a terrorism-related charge and an international arrest warrant, while a separate French case remains open.

items.title: Trade.xyz to cover SK Hynix perp liquidation losses tied to price anomaly
items.summary: Trade.xyz said its oracle worked as designed but will reimburse eligible traders after an external SK Hynix price print caused the contract’s mark price to fall nearly 19%.

items.title: Uniswap founder rejects claims v4 fees reduce LP earnings
items.summary: Hayden Adams said critics misunderstood Uniswap’s newly approved v4 protocol fees, rejecting claims the change reduces liquidity providers’ earnings.
